info.name: WAB Merchant API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand.

item.name: Auth
OTP pre-check

request.description: Public. Checks the platform limits before the app asks Firebase to send the SMS. A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false`.

item.name: Report a wrong OTP code

request.description: Public. The app reports a wrong code from Firebase; it counts toward the wrong-attempts block.

item.name: Check a number before sending the OTP

request.description: 404 `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` when the number is not linked to a salon (the app offers to register one); 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` when the owner removed the member.

item.name: Log in with a Firebase ID token

request.description: The token must prove the phone. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), `OTP_BLOCKED` (429), `MEMBER_INACTIVE` (403), `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` (404). The profile carries role, salon and permissions for the app to cache.

item.name: Rotate the refresh token

request.description: Returns a new token pair and the current profile. Reusing an old refresh token ends every session of that login (401). A removed member gets 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` and all sessions end.

item.name: Log out

request.description: Revokes the refresh token and unlinks the device. Always succeeds for well-formed tokens.

item.name: Installations
Register or update this device

request.description: Firebase app-instance id, FCM token and versions. Links the device to the signed-in member so the salon's booking requests reach it.

item.name: App config
Version policy, maintenance, OTP and discovery settings

request.description: Public. Called at launch with the installed version: tells the app whether it must or may update, whether maintenance is on, plus OTP length/resend and the nearby radius.

Salon profile
My salon: profile, state and what is still missing (any member)

Get a presigned upload URL for a purpose (type, size and expiry are restricted)

Public: confirm an uploaded license document
Salon gallery
Gallery in display order (GALLERY_MANAGE)
Add a confirmed upload to the gallery (appended last)
Reorder: send every item id exactly once in the new order
Delete an item and its files
Working hours
Weekly schedule, upcoming closures and today’s hours (WORKING_HOURS_MANAGE)
Replace the weekly schedule (7 days, slot-aligned, close after open). 409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT lists bookings the change would break.
Add an exceptional closure (dates in the salon calendar, `to` inclusive, not in the past)
Change a closure that has not started
Remove a closure that has not started
Salon services
The salon’s services (SERVICES_MANAGE), paginated
Offer a catalog service (same gender as the salon; bride-only only in women’s salons; once per salon)
Change price, duration, bride-only, description, media or switch the service off (active=false)
Catalog requests
The salon’s catalog requests with status and admin note (SERVICES_MANAGE)
Ask the admin to add a service to the catalog (optional confirmed CATALOG_IMAGE upload)
Team
Team members (STAFF_MANAGE; the owner always)
Add a member (OWNER only): the member can sign in with that phone; permissions start from the role template unless sent
One member (STAFF_MANAGE)
Change name, photo, role or permissions (OWNER only). Owner-only capabilities can never be granted; the OWNER’s own role and permissions cannot change (422 LAST_OWNER).
Switch a member off: all sessions end and devices are detached (OWNER only; the owner cannot be deactivated)
Switch a member on again (OWNER only)
Staff
Staff profile of a member (STAFF_MANAGE)

Save the staff profile: skills are salon service ids, working days are open salon days (custom hours inside the salon hours, slot-aligned), bride qualification only in women’s salons. Completeness is recomputed.
Staff leaves
Leaves of a staff member that have not ended (STAFF_MANAGE)
Add a leave (salon calendar dates, `to` inclusive, not in the past). 409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT lists affected bookings.
Change a leave that has not started
Remove a leave that has not started
